name: yue2-music
title: YuE2-music
job_to_be_done: Turn recurring local music briefs into suitable native YuE2 modes, reproducible full songs, constrained score edits, and measured listening comparisons.

trigger_surface.description: Use YuE2 / mlx-Yue on Apple Silicon to generate music, optimize generation settings, transcribe audio to ABC/MIDI, cover songs, edit scores or lyrics, render saved plans, replay audio, batch variants, and compare 8/32-step audio and RTF. 用 YuE2 本机作曲、翻唱、改谱、换词、转谱、调参和试听对比。Do not route explicit ACE-Step/Suno jobs, waveform inpainting, voice cloning, or guaranteed exact melody replacement here.
should_trigger: 用 YuE2 生成中文民谣整曲
mlx-Yue 做 8 步快速模式
YuE2 把音频转 ABC 再翻唱
YuE2 原曲旋律保留并换和声
YuE2 32 步和 8 步试听对比，给出 RTF
用 YuE2 写歌词先不生成
YuE2 用 supplied melody score 生成
YuE2 直接 off 生成有人声的歌
should_not_trigger: 修改 Python 的单元测试
只帮我发一条 X 推广帖子
edge_cases: 用 YuE2 做 waveform inpainting
YuE2 voice cloning 克隆歌手音色
帮我审查 YuE2 仓库代码

steps: Resolve local project, runtime, models and resource constraints.
Interpret brief, preserve hard constraints, write singable lyrics/style.
Choose full/melody/off and generated/supplied ABC or transcribe source.
Preflight effective native request, then run sequentially with suitable profile.
Retain artifacts, validate technical checks, measure wall time/RTF/memory.
Refine bounded candidates using actual listening criteria and controlled step comparisons.
decision_points: Source audio versus supplied ABC versus original composition.
Full harmony control versus melody condition versus direct synthesis.
Fast 8-step versus standard 32-step versus BF16 reference.
New semantic generation for musical edits versus same-input acoustic resynthesis.
failure_modes: Token budget exhaustion presented as full song.
Implicitly overwritten user settings or artifacts.
Estimated stage-summed time presented as actual end-to-end timing.
Incorrect metadata distribution after project rename.
Unsupported claim of best music quality or exact acoustic melody preservation.

adversarial: evals/trigger_cases.json: foreign engines, voice cloning and waveform inpainting
evals/test_contract.py: invalid counts, mismatched mode/ABC, existing output preservation
eval_plan.baseline: Existing project skill and native protocol defaults; no blind human listening baseline.

governance.review_cadence: On mlx-Yue API/model changes; review proposed every 90 days
